func (g *lxdAgent) handleProcd() error {
	lxdAgentProcdScript := `#!/etc/rc.common
START=05
STOP=85
USE_PROCD=1

start_service() {
	# set up the /run/lxd_agent directory
	if [ ! -x /usr/local/sbin/lxd-agent-setup ]; then
		echo "lxd-agent-setup script not found"
		return 1
	fi

	/usr/local/sbin/lxd-agent-setup || return $?

	procd_open_instance
	# procd can't change directory, so we need a wrapper script
	procd_set_param command /usr/local/sbin/lxd-agent-wrapper
	# wait 5 seconds before restarting;
	# if it fails more than 10 times in 5 minutes, consider it crashed
	procd_set_param respawn 300 5 10
	procd_set_param stdout 1
	procd_set_param stderr 1
}

service_stopped() {
	umount -l /run/lxd_agent
	rmdir /run/lxd_agent
}
`

	lxdAgentWrapperScript := `#!/bin/sh
if [ ! -d /run/lxd_agent ]; then
	echo "lxd-agent runtime directory /run/lxd_agent not present!"
	exit 1
fi

cd /run/lxd_agent

exec /run/lxd_agent/lxd-agent $@
`

	initPath := filepath.Join(g.sourceDir, "/etc/init.d/lxd-agent")

	err := os.WriteFile(initPath, []byte(lxdAgentProcdScript), 0o755)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("Failed to write file %q: %w", initPath, err)
	}

	initPathStart := filepath.Join(g.sourceDir, "/etc/rc.d/S05lxd-agent")
	err = os.Symlink("/etc/init.d/lxd-agent", initPathStart)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("Failed to create symlink %q: %w", initPathStart, err)
	}

	initPathKill := filepath.Join(g.sourceDir, "/etc/rc.d/K85lxd-agent")
	err = os.Symlink("/etc/init.d/lxd-agent", initPathKill)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("Failed to create symlink %q: %w", initPathKill, err)
	}

	// not present by default on openwrt
	sbinPath := filepath.Join(g.sourceDir, "/usr/local/sbin")

	err = os.MkdirAll(sbinPath, 0o755)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("Failed to create directory %q: %w", sbinPath, err)
	}

	wrapperPath := filepath.Join(g.sourceDir, "/usr/local/sbin", "lxd-agent-wrapper")

	err = os.WriteFile(wrapperPath, []byte(lxdAgentWrapperScript), 0o755)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("Failed to write file %q: %w", wrapperPath, err)
	}

	setupPath := filepath.Join(g.sourceDir, "/usr/local/sbin", "lxd-agent-setup")

	err = os.WriteFile(setupPath, []byte(lxdAgentSetupScript), 0o755)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("Failed to write file %q: %w", setupPath, err)
	}

	return nil
}
